text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
U-ugh, I can't move! I'm totally
defenseless
against the powers of evil
right now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Pull yourself together, Biko! Want me to
give you
a piggyback ride?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Anything but that! A hero always walks
on her
own two feet!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No matter the crisis... or danger...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ☆ That was my Japanese and
Western
fusion full course meal! ☆ I'm so
happy you
cleaned every single plate!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It was a homemade present from you, so
of
course I'd finish it! A hero would never
leave
leftovers!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I almost forgot about the chocolate
ice
cream cake I made. It should have
cooled down
by now, so let's take it out
and dig in!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Th-there's still more?! U-ugh... I won't
fall here!
